description: Frozen experiment protocol for unified ETF strategy backtesting

timing_definitions.signal_date: Date when factor signals are computed from available data (index signal_idx = full_idx - signal_to_return_lag)
timing_definitions.order_submit_date: Signal date + 1 trading day (implicit; not stored as separate column)
timing_definitions.execution_date: The backtest date T itself: positions determined by signal at T - signal_to_return_lag are held during T
timing_definitions.return_accounting_date: Same as execution date T. Daily net return is recorded for date T using target weights determined by the delayed signal

signal_to_return_lag.description: Signal computed at T-2, order executes at T-1 NAV, first held return is T/T-1. With daily NAV data, lag=2 means the signal at date D is observed after market close, the order executes at next-day NAV, and the first held return is the day-after-next NAV change

rebalance_every.description: Portfolio weights are recalculated every 5 trading days. Between rebalances, weights drift with price returns.

cost_formulas.gross_traded_notional: sum of absolute weight changes across all symbols: sum(|w_after - w_before|)
cost_formulas.gross_return_daily: sum(weight_i * ret_i) for all held positions + cash_weight * cash_daily_return
cost_formulas.turnover_unit_explanation: Dividing gross traded notional by 2 converts buy-sell pairs into a single turnover ratio (conventional definition: one full portfolio turn = 1.0)

B0_BuyHold_EW.description: Equal-weight buy and hold of all PIT-eligible symbols at first rebalance date
B0_BuyHold_EW.rebalance: only at initialization (buy_and_hold=True); weights drift thereafter

S04_VolTarget_Trend.description: Volatility-targeted trend following in low-vol regime

S23_Oversold_Long.description: Oversold bounce strategy in mean-reversion regime

reproducibility_rules.repeatability_test: Same config run twice must produce identical summary metrics and artifact SHA256 (excluding timestamp fields)
